title: Foundations, Constructions & Geometric Reasoning
standards_support: Make formal geometric constructions with a compass and straightedge.
Use definitions and properties precisely when reasoning about geometric figures.
Use coordinates to compute distances and midpoints and to represent segment relationships.
Distinguish conjecture, counterexample, postulate, theorem, and proof.
Construct viable geometric arguments and critique invalid or unsupported reasoning.
mathematical_practices: Make sense of problems and persevere in solving them
Construct viable arguments and critique the reasoning of others
Look for and make use of structure
unit_evidence: 12-question mastery check drawn from the hardened bank
Teacher or family review of open-response construction and proof evidence
